title: Differential Heatmap Prober for FP8/INT8 Calibration and Gate
creator: Aisha Patel
description: Build an automated validation harness that produces per-layer and per-query differential heatmaps comparing FP8 and INT8 candidate profiles against FP16 baselines. The harness will drive calibration pipelines, compute windowed significance on metric deltas, and output a pass/fail gate decision for rollouts. Key goals: 1) make sensitivity visible as dense heatmaps (layer x prompt cohort), 2) define statistically-sound pass/fail heuristics that combine aggregate metrics and high-impact outlier detection, and 3) integrate results into the CI gating job so that canary and full rollouts can automatically block on regressions.
acceptance_criteria: Harness generates layer-by-cohort heatmaps for a given quant profile and baseline for any model in our catalog
Heatmaps include normalized delta metrics (e.g., perplexity delta, ROUGE-sim delta, embedding cosine delta) and a per-cell significance flag computed with windowed bootstrap
Gate logic produces a deterministic pass/fail verdict and an actionable summary (top-5 failing cohorts, per-layer suspects) for use by release automation
CI job fails when gate returns FAIL and posts a link to the detailed heatmap artifacts and a minimal triage checklist
Dashboard integration: heatmaps and time-series deltas available in Console under 'Quant QA' with trace links to PR and calibration run
End-to-end run for a sample FP8 profile completed in under 45 minutes on dedicated validation pool (with caching reuse)
Documentation (Confluence) with algorithm description, thresholds rationale, and on-call triage steps published
steps: Spike: prototype heatmap generation from existing golden-prompt runner (scripts/heatmap_spike) — done
Define cohorting rules and golden sets; augment with adversarial perturbations to stress layer sensitivity
Implement differential metrics module that normalizes across prompt length and tokenization artifacts
Add windowed bootstrap significance tester and false-discovery-rate correction for per-cell flags
Design gate policy language: combine weighted aggregate delta and top-outlier penalties
Hook harness into calibration pipeline (calib-runner) and ensure KV/prefix caching is reused
Integrate artifact upload (S3) and Console ingestion for visualization
Add CI pipeline step and smoke-test on staging dedicated pool
Write runbook and docs; collect initial reviewer feedback
progress_updates: 2026-02-11: Spike completed — heatmap generator prototype produces layer x cohort CSVs for GPT-like models using existing golden prompts. Baseline comparison against FP16 validated for a single model.
2026-02-13: Cohorting rules drafted. Added adversarial perturbations (synonym swapping, truncation, injection) to surface brittle contexts.

2026-02-15: Implemented delta metrics (perplexity, embedding cosine, token-error-rate) and a first-pass normalization by sequence length. Found large tokenizer mismatch artifacts for one model — added tokenization alignment step.

2026-02-17: Windowed bootstrap implementation finished; initial FDR correction applied across heatmap cells. Observed persistent layer-3 delta spikes on two FP8 profiles; created ENG-731001 to investigate kernel scheduling interaction.

2026-02-19: CI gating prototype wired to staging job. The gating job uploads HTML heatmap report and a JSON summary. Not yet deterministic due to small-sample variance; next sprint: increase cohort sizes and add stability aggregation.
2026-02-20: UX design review scheduled with Console team 2026-02-24 to finalize visualization spec and drilldowns. Planning to request dedicated validation capacity for full run performance testing.
